theorems.statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [HopfAlgebra k H] (K : Subalgebra k H) (hΔ : (∀ x ∈ K, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) x ∈ Submodule.span k {t : TensorProduct k H H | ∃ a ∈ K, ∃ b ∈ K, t = TensorProduct.tmul k a b})) (hS : (∀ x ∈ K, HopfAlgebra.antipode k x ∈ K)) (x : H), (TensorProduct.tmul K x (1 : H) : TensorProduct K H H) = TensorProduct.tmul K (1 : H) x → x ∈ K
theorems.natural_summary: Applies the tensor relation to H/K, then uses accepted finite-witness, Hopf-envelope, stable-subspace, and retraction lemmas to show the quotient class vanishes.
